g.aria-label: Chunked WY Representation: m × m Unit Lower-Triangular Solve
Why Chunked WY Unlocks Tensor-Core Speed for Data-Dependent Transitions
• Within each length-m chunk (m = 32 or 64), M is inverted across all B × H chunks in parallel
• Once U is found, chunk outputs Y and boundary state S_m use the exact same GEMMs as GLA!
